No recent break. Standard adaptive progression.
Short break. Quick ramp-up back to your usual training volume.
Moderate break. WallCrawl starts you at a conservative volume and builds back up.
Significant break. Sets and starting loads are scaled down while you rebuild your baseline.
Extended hiatus of a year or more. Volume is capped at 2 sets per movement while you rebuild your baseline.

This permanently removes your profile and preferences, movement answers, saved templates, every logged workout including one in progress, and cached weekly totals. It cannot be undone, and the app returns to first-run onboarding. Files you already exported are not deleted. Exercise artwork and the bundled catalog stay. Your language choice is a device setting and is left as it is.
